question: Which of the following gas is the other name for 'Marsh Gas'?
solution:
The correct answer is "__**Methane**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The **methane is (also known as) marsh gas** because it is **found near the surface of marshy areas (wetland or areas of land where water covers**__ the ground for long periods of time which are usually treeless and is dominated by grasses and herbaceous plants).
 
•
